decision_rule.quality_gain: paired task-cluster 95% lower bound > 0 against BOTH single and fixed
decision_rule.latency_exception: family paired quality lower bound >= -0.05 and p50 latency <= 0.80 of both baselines
decision_rule.cost_guard: multi tokens per successful task <= 1.20 of each baseline, all usage known
decision_rule.default: single or fixed when quality gain unclear and cost rises
decision_rule.scope: exploratory only; 10 tasks/family and no multiplicity correction

dev.question: Return the failing modules, alphabetically, comma-separated.
materials: auth: permission checked after write; invariant: check before write.
billing: amount is integer cents as required.
trace: saves raw api_key; invariant: never persist credentials.

dev.question: Which checks pass? Return sorted IDs comma-separated.
materials: a: expected HTTP 403, actual 403.
b: expected one receipt, actual two.
c: expected terminal succeeded, actual succeeded.

dev.question: Find the highest severity module: p0 is higher than p1 or p2.
materials: cache is p2.
router is p1.
ledger is p0.

dev.question: Return modules requiring a database migration, sorted.
materials: alpha only changes documentation.
beta adds a durable table.
gamma adds a nullable stored column.

dev.question: Return the final state after the events.
materials: Start queued. start: queued -> running. finish: running -> succeeded.
Events in order: start, finish.

dev.question: Return remaining budget as a decimal integer.
materials: Initial budget 20. Reserve 8. Settlement releases reservation then charges actual 5.
After settlement charge a further 4.

dev.question: Return the final artifact version.
materials: Input source is v2. Build maps v2 -> artifact b7.
Review of b7 produces release r9.

dev.question: Return the admitted node IDs in execution order.
materials: a has no dependencies. b depends on a. c depends on b.
All nodes succeed; scheduler runs only nodes with completed dependencies.

dev.question: Choose retry, reconcile, or fail.
materials: A non-idempotent payment was dispatched. Response was lost.
No authoritative receipt is currently available.

dev.question: Choose execute or request_approval.
materials: Approval binds content digest x. Current content digest is y.
An approval may authorize only its exact approved digest.

dev.question: Choose execute or deny.
materials: Caller was authorized at submission; caller is revoked before tool admission.
Policy requires current authorization at each admission.

dev.question: Choose answer or clarify.
materials: Request: delete the old record. There are two equally old records.
Deletion requires one unambiguous record ID.

Module quartz: GPL-3.0-only. Allowed licenses: MIT, Apache-2.0.
Module river: Apache-2.0. Allowed licenses: MIT, Apache-2.0.

evaluation.question: Return the endpoint leaking another tenant's resource.
materials: /orders checks owner tenant == actor tenant.
/files looks up by global ID without a tenant predicate.
/notes queries WHERE tenant_id = actor.tenant_id.

evaluation.question: Return the test that detects a genuine boundary defect.
materials: test_a: limit 5 accepts consumption 5, as specified.
test_b: limit 5 accepts consumption 6, but maximum is inclusive 5.
test_c: limit 5 rejects consumption 7, as specified.

evaluation.question: Return the service eligible for cache reuse.
materials: oak: cached revision v1, current revision v2.
pine: cached revision v3, current revision v3, permission valid.
elm: cached revision v4, current revision v4, permission revoked.

evaluation.question: Return sorted modules violating the no-core-to-domain-import rule.
materials: api/core.py imports domain.legal.
sdk/core.py imports json.
runtime/core.py imports domain.commerce.

evaluation.question: Return the schema change compatible with an old required-field reader.
materials: change_a removes the required status field.
change_b adds an optional note field; preserves all old fields and meanings.
change_c changes required integer counter to an object.

evaluation.question: Which implementation preserves sorted unique IDs? Return its ID.
materials: impl_a: list(set(ids)); order is unspecified.
impl_b: sorted(set(ids)).
impl_c: sorted(ids); duplicates remain.

evaluation.question: Return the log entry permitted by the privacy policy.
materials: entry_a stores the bearer token verbatim; forbidden.
entry_b stores a credential-free request digest; allowed.
entry_c stores the database password verbatim; forbidden.

evaluation.question: Return the worker configuration that prevents duplicate row claims.
materials: config_a selects then updates in separate unguarded transactions.
config_b reads rows without claiming them.
config_c uses an atomic conditional UPDATE and checks affected-row count.

evaluation.question: Return the function that checks a Python list for emptiness correctly.
materials: f_a: len(items) < 0.
f_b: not items.
f_c: items is [].

evaluation.question: Return the total physical invocation count.
materials: Logical call x has attempts x1 failed, x2 failed, x3 succeeded.
Logical call y has attempt y1 succeeded. Count attempts, not logical calls.

evaluation.question: Return the final HTTP status.
materials: Domain exception SourceGone maps to ResourceUnavailable.
ResourceUnavailable maps to HTTP 410. Other exceptions map to 500.

evaluation.question: Return the earliest node whose output becomes invalid.
materials: graph: retrieve -> summarize -> publish. retrieve depends on source rev 4.
Source changes to rev 5. Invalidate directly affected outputs before descendants.

evaluation.question: Return the surviving committed rows after recovery.
materials: Transaction T inserts draft and receipt, then crashes before COMMIT.
Before T there were 2 drafts and 2 receipts. SQLite rolls back uncommitted changes.
Format: drafts,receipts.

evaluation.question: Return the final outbox consumer balance.
materials: Start balance 0. Event e1 adds 7. Event e2 subtracts 2.
Delivery: e1,e2,e1. Consumer deduplicates by event ID.

evaluation.question: Return the critical path duration in seconds.
materials: A takes 2 seconds. B and C start after A, taking 5 and 3 seconds in parallel.
D starts after both B and C and takes 4 seconds. No overhead.

evaluation.question: Return the authorization result: allow or deny.
materials: Access requires active user AND tenant match AND resource grant.
User active=true; tenant matches=true; resource grant=false.

evaluation.question: Return the final stock count.
materials: Stock starts 10. Request k1 reserves 3; request k2 reserves 2.
Request k1 repeats; idempotency prevents a second reservation. Then k2 is refunded.

evaluation.question: Return the number of records after the specified pipeline.
materials: Inputs: [a(active), b(deleted), a(active), c(active)]. First remove deleted.
Then deduplicate by ID. Then keep the first two records.

evaluation.question: Return when the next retry is admitted, in milliseconds after start.
materials: Attempt 1 fails at t=10ms; backoff before attempt 2 is 100ms.
Attempt 2 runs 20ms and fails. Backoff before attempt 3 doubles to 200ms.

evaluation.question: Choose reuse or reject.
materials: An idempotency key already binds payload hash a. New request uses hash b.
The contract forbids reusing a key with different content.

evaluation.question: Choose estimate_zero or retain_reservation.
materials: Provider accepted a model request but the response contains no usage.
The budget contract requires authoritative actual usage for settlement.

evaluation.question: Choose publish or wait.
materials: Join requires all dependencies completed. Left branch completed. Right branch failed.
There is no configured partial-result publication mode.

evaluation.question: Choose retry_read or reconcile_write.
materials: A read-only lookup timed out, with no side effects and known zero cost.
One safe retry remains under the attempt and wall-clock budgets.

evaluation.question: Choose continue or stop.
materials: A run's persisted deadline is 12:00 UTC. Current time is 12:01 UTC.
Restarting a process must not renew the deadline. The next node has not started.

evaluation.question: Choose discard_receipt or preserve_receipt.
materials: Cancellation arrived while an admitted external write was executing.
The external system confirms the write committed. Cancellation cannot undo it.

evaluation.question: Choose loop or fail_bounded.
materials: The model returned an illegal tool-call structure on all 3 permitted attempts.
The violation retry allowance is now exhausted.

evaluation.question: Choose accept or reject.
materials: A page's stored SHA-256 describes text A, but current page text is B.
A citation refers to the page. Verification requires a matching content digest.

evaluation.question: Choose steal_owner or refuse_takeover.
materials: Another live process holds the local flock and is blocked on a tool.
The single-machine runtime cannot steal an active owner's lock.

evaluation.question: Choose migrate_implicitly or reject_version.
materials: Stored checkpoint schema is v99; installed runtime understands only v1 and v2.
No explicit migration exists. Unknown future schemas must fail closed.

tool_visibility.single: registered material tool schemas; ReAct controls calls
tool_visibility.fixed: deterministic material reads; final model call has no tool schemas
tool_visibility.multi: deterministic material reads; planner/worker/reviewer have no tool schemas
tool_visibility.authority: same registered tool and policy; schema omission grants no authority
